ascending_triangle.description: Pivot-fitted ascending triangle with >=2 flat resistance touches and rising support pivots.

computed_trendlines.description: OLS upper resistance and lower support lines fitted on confirmed order-2 swing pivots.

double_bottom.description: Double bottom 'W' reversal with second trough within tolerance and daily close above peak neckline.

double_top.description: Double top 'M' reversal with second peak within tolerance and daily close below trough neckline.

inverse_head_and_shoulders.description: Inverse Head & Shoulders pattern with chronological left shoulder, head, right shoulder and neckline breakout.

regular_head_and_shoulders.description: Regular Head & Shoulders pattern with chronological left shoulder, head, right shoulder and neckline breakdown.

ATR.formula: TrueRange = max(H-L, |H-C_prev|, |L-C_prev|); Wilder EWM alpha=1/14, min_periods=14

Anchored_VWAP.initialization: Deterministic swing extremum anchor (first occurrence breaks ties).

Bollinger_Bands.formula: Mid = SMA(20); Upper/Lower = Mid +/- 2.0 * STD(20, ddof=0)
Bollinger_Bands.initialization: Population standard deviation over 20 completed bars; None before 20 bars.

EMA.initialization: Recursive first-close seed; returns None before N completed bars.

MACD.formula: MACD = EMA(12) - EMA(26); Signal = EWM(MACD, span=9, adjust=False, min_periods=9)

SMA.initialization: Simple arithmetic mean; returns None before N completed bars.

Volume_Profile.formula: Uniform bar-range distribution across 24 equal price bins over [min(Low), max(High)]
Volume_Profile.initialization: POC = max-volume bin midpoint; Value Area covers 70% cumulative volume; requires >= 20 positive-volume bars.

Wilder_RSI.initialization: Wilder recursive smoothing with min_periods=N; None before N bars; flat series -> 50.0.

limitations: Range and directional breakout rules are uncalibrated research conditions, not win probabilities or trading edge.
Withdrawn heuristic detectors (descending_triangle, falling_wedge, rising_wedge, preset_wave_targets) remain disabled pending certified fit policies.
Missing optional external domains: benchmark, sector, company_fundamentals, news, macro.
Volume Profile POC/VAH/VAL unavailable due to insufficient positive-volume history.
Diagnostic-only packet: lacks a verified zero-issue validation receipt and cannot be published as an accepted assessment.

opening_volume.statistic: median opening volume; same session duration; complete 15m bars
